about: Lab PR 246: the other order of the same trip. The close of the refused connect reaches the engine before the trip (the close ring read first; past the drain's wait for its connect, or with the connect lost): it is judged as any flow, before any precursor, and noted as an egress for a precursor processed later (review 70). The trip then owns the connection and drops that note: a credential read of the shell processed after both, though made before the connect, is the read's record alone (NN-L-FIM-016) — no NN-L-CHAIN-001 completed with the trip's own connection. A later flow of the shell is an egress after the read and the trip: NN-L-CHAIN-001 and NN-L-CHAIN-003.
